feedback_driven.quote: TeleTune uses action-prediction errors on logged trajectories to propose library edits and keep only those that improve held-out action-prediction accuracy

persists_across_tasks.quote: At test time, the agent is provided with the learned library and the workflow-based retrieved demonstrations.
